uart: 64-byte TX and RX FIFOs; fractional baud-rate generator.
5-8 data bits, parity, break, loopback and receive diagnostics.
UART0 connects DMA and RTS/CTS; UART1 has its own integration limits.
i2c: Two controller instances with 7-bit and 10-bit addressing.
Sixteen-entry command/RX queues, repeated START and clock stretching.
Arbitration detection, bounded recovery and DMA pacing.
i2s: Stereo master TX/RX with independent audio clock.
16/24-bit and 48/96 kHz presets; programmable clock division.
32-bit streams and CDC FIFOs; no slave, TDM or PDM mode.
ws2812: 24-bit GRB transmission on one GPIO alternate function.
Sixteen-word FIFO, frame length and programmable pulse/reset timings.
Explicit underflow, abort and completion reporting.
timer: 16-bit prescalers and two compare channels per instance.
Periodic/one-shot modes, count direction and debug freeze.
gpio: 32 bidirectional GPIOs with administration and restricted user windows.
Atomic output commands, open drain, filtering and per-pin interrupts.
Alternate-function ownership, guard cycles and irreversible locks.
clint: Per-hart software interrupts and 64-bit timer compare.
Shared 64-bit timebase with RV32 word access.
One management hart slot in the reference integration.
aclint: Two addressable hart slots; HP consumes slot 1.
Machine software and timer interrupts for the HP subsystem.
Separate address window from management CLINT.
dma: Eight channel contexts share a 32-bit AXI master.
Up to 16-beat bursts and selected AXI4-Stream endpoints.
sysctrl: Root-managed configuration, HP lifecycle and clock requests.
Sticky first-fault capture and performance snapshots.
Sticky firmware test result and RTC wake observation.
psram: Four ESP-PSRAM64H devices addressable through a 32 MiB window.
Separate APB management, recovery and timing configuration.
sdram: Fixed 64 MiB, x16 SDR geometry with bank/row tracking.
Burst-capable AXI frontend and periodic refresh.
Programmable device timing in SDRAM-clock cycles.
opipsram: One octal DDR memory interface and one selected protocol profile.
OPI or single-clock HyperBus-style digital transaction model.
Training/recovery controls; external-device qualification remains required.
xpi: Four chip-select slots and 16 programmable LUT sequences.
SDR transfers over one, two or four data pads.
Mapped reads, indirect PIO/DMA and automatic status polling.
spisd: Private AXI DMA and scatter-gather descriptors.
CRC, timeout, PIO and explicit card-command completion.
sdio: SD Memory/SDIO command support with per-lane CRC.
Private descriptor DMA and separate instance integration.
jpeg: 8-bit Baseline Sequential JPEG encode or decode.
Images up to 2048 × 2048; modes are mutually exclusive.
Private AXI64 DMA, direct jobs and a scatter-gather ring.
apu: Coreless microcode sequencer with private DMA and local storage.
WAV/FLAC job and stream infrastructure in the current capability word.
MP3/KWS are not advertised; production bundle and capacity qualification remain distinct gates.
dvp: Programmable sync polarity, sample edge, crop and snapshot mode.
Word packing with start-of-frame/end-of-line stream markers.
usb2: Dual-role digital controller with external 8-bit ULPI PHY.
Eight device endpoints, sixteen host channels and 16 KiB packet RAM.
Descriptor DMA, IRQ/error retention and role-specific control.
crypto: Protected key/exponent readback; no claim of a secure key vault or certification.
mailbox: Separate LP-to-HP and HP-to-LP payload banks.
Doorbells and independently masked interrupt state.
Boot/lifecycle message exchange with explicit publication ordering.
sram: 32 KiB in the reference profile, using eight 4 KiB banks.
Native AXI64 data frontend and byte-write support.
rtc: Two alarms, periodic wake timer and signed calibration.
Asynchronous command handoff and coherent snapshots.
wdg: Two-key servicing, early warning and retained reset cause.
Configuration locks and explicit debug policy.
pwm: Two timers, four output channels and two operators.
Fault handling and two capture inputs.
crc: Polynomial, initialization, reflection, byte order and final XOR controls.
Byte-strobed input, running state and latched result.
rng: Entropy-source qualification, FIFO and continuous health checks.
Sticky errors, counters and bounded reads.
The integrated deterministic source is unqualified for production entropy.
ps2: Sixteen-entry RX/TX FIFOs and input filtering.
Start/parity/stop checks, inhibit, timeouts and abort.
archinfo: Read-only identity, configuration and topology discovery.
Generated build provenance and memory/technology capabilities.
resource: Owner locks, quiesce/reset and LP/HP IRQ routing.
Explicit cache-maintenance handoff and sticky faults.
monitor: Eight master and six target observation banks.
Saturating counters, snapshots and outstanding high-water marks.
Sticky first-fault attribution and live isolation status.
extensions: Fixed EXT-H control, ownership, bounds and lifecycle.
AXI64 data-master interface with address-range checking.
DMA service registers and timeout/fault reporting.
ext-l: Fixed APB4 control and one interrupt.
Ownership, lock, quiesce and reset control.
No data master, stream interface or local SRAM.
rcu: Safe-source fallback, traffic drain and PLL qualification.
Clock division and memory-pad mode through SYSCTRL.
plic: Two delivery contexts: machine and supervisor.
Priorities, masks, threshold and claim/complete semantics.
mpw-timer: Small register window and user-GPIO output.
No PRODUCT instantiation or dedicated IRQ claim.
mpw-gpio: MPW-selectable user GPIO data and enables.
Readback of the shared user-GPIO input bus.
Selection and pad ownership remain root-controlled.
